records.jp: おいしいよね、りんご飴。<CR>お祭りの時はいっつも買っちゃう
records.en_original: Don't you love candied apples? I always end up getting one at festivals.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't you love candied apples? I always end up getting one at festivals.
records.en: Don't you love candied apples?<CR>I always end up getting one at festivals.

records.jp: スイーツ系の屋台って他にもいろいろあるけど、<CR>りんご飴ってその代表って感じするよね
records.en_original: There are plenty of other kinds of sweets, but I feel like candied apples are the classic.
records.en_auxiliary: There are plenty of other kinds of sweets, but I feel like candied apples are the classic.
records.en: There are plenty of other kinds of sweets,<CR>but candied apples feel like the classic festival treat.

records.jp: 見た目がインパクトあるからかな？
records.en_original: Maybe because they have a unique appearance.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe because they have a unique appearance.
records.en: Maybe because they have a unique appearance.

records.jp: 店先に置いてあったら目立つもんね
records.en_original: They do stand out when they're on display.
records.en_auxiliary: They do stand out when they're on display.
records.en: They do stand out when they're on display.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんは屋台のお菓子だったら、何が一番好き？
records.en_original: Say, what's your favorite treat when it comes to festival booths, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Say, what's your favorite treat when it comes to festival booths, Ao?
records.en: Say, what's your favorite treat when it comes to festival booths, Ao-chan?

records.jp: わたあめかなあ。定番だけど
records.en_original: It's not too exciting, but cotton candy for me.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not too exciting, but cotton candy for me.
records.en: It's not too exciting, but cotton candy for me.

records.jp: あー。ふわふわしてておいしいよね
records.en_original: Ooh, that's a good one too.
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, that's a good one too.
records.en: Ooh, that's a good one too.

records.jp: アニメのキャラが描かれた袋とかに入っててさ。<CR>子供の頃はよくお母さんに買ってもらってたなあ
records.en_original: I used to always ask my mom to buy me some whenever I saw the ones with the characters printed on the bag.
records.en_auxiliary: I used to always ask my mom to buy me some whenever I saw the ones with the characters printed on the bag.
records.en: They came in bags with anime characters on them.<CR>Mom used to buy them for me all the time when I was little.

records.jp: それって、わたあめじゃなくて<CR>袋が欲しかったんじゃ……？
records.en_original: Are you sure you didn't just want the bag?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you sure you didn't just want the bag?
records.en: Are you sure you didn't<CR>just want the bag?

records.jp: ……そうかも
records.en_original: Now that you mention it...
records.en_auxiliary: Now that you mention it...
records.en: Now that you mention it...

records.jp: りんご飴と同じ果物系で……チョコバナナかな
records.en_original: It's not too different from candied apples, but I'd go with chocolate covered bananas.
records.en_auxiliary: It's not too different from candied apples, but I'd go with chocolate covered bananas.
records.en: It's not too different from candied apples, but I'd go with chocolate covered bananas.

records.jp: 甘くておいしいよね
records.en_original: I like those too.
records.en_auxiliary: I like those too.
records.en: I like those too.

records.jp: わたしも前、無性に食べたくなって<CR>自分で作ろうとしたことがあるんだけど……
records.en_original: That reminds me, one time I was craving them so bad, I tried to make some myself.
records.en_auxiliary: That reminds me, one time I was craving them so bad, I tried to make some myself.
records.en: That reminds me, one time I was craving<CR>them so bad, I tried to make some myself.

records.jp: 自作する発想はなかった……。でも、チョコ溶かして<CR>バナナにかけるだけだし結構簡単だったり？
records.en_original: I'm not much of a cook, but it's just bananas and chocolate, right?
records.en_auxiliary: I'm not much of a cook, but it's just bananas and chocolate, right?
records.en: I never thought of making them myself... But you only melt chocolate<CR>and pour it over bananas, so is it fairly easy?

records.jp: それがチョコの温度管理とか結構難しくて。<CR>なかなかいい感じにならないの
records.en_original: You'd think. Turns out that chocolate is really sensitive to temperature.
records.en_auxiliary: You'd think. Turns out that chocolate is really sensitive to temperature.
records.en: Actually, keeping the chocolate at the right temperature is pretty tricky.<CR>It's hard to get it to come out just right.

records.jp: 何度も作り直してようやく完成したんだけど、<CR>しばらくチョコもバナナも見たくなくなっちゃった……
records.en_original: I tried over and over, and eventually got it right, but after that I thought that I never wanted to see another chocolate banana again.
records.en_auxiliary: I tried over and over, and eventually got it right, but after that I thought that I never wanted to see another chocolate banana again.
records.en: It took me a bunch of tries to finally get them right,<CR>but afterward I didn't want to see chocolate or bananas for a while...

records.jp: うわあ……
records.en_original: Yeesh...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeesh...
records.en: Yeesh...

records.jp: でも、定番の屋台もいいけど、<CR>珍しいスイーツの屋台も作ってみたいよね
records.en_original: The classics are always nice, but sometimes something a little different would be good too.
records.en_auxiliary: The classics are always nice, but sometimes something a little different would be good too.
records.en: The classics are always nice, but sometimes<CR>something a little different would be good too.

records.jp: 例えば？
records.en_original: What were you thinking?
records.en_auxiliary: What were you thinking?
records.en: What were you thinking?

records.jp: ほら、アイスとかフルーツとか<CR>たくさん使った豪勢なパフェとかさ
records.en_original: Ooh, how about a deluxe parfait with scoops of ice cream and a bunch of fruit on top?
records.en_auxiliary: Ooh, how about a deluxe parfait with scoops of ice cream and a bunch of fruit on top?
records.en: Ooh, how about a deluxe parfait with scoops<CR>of ice cream and a bunch of fruit on top?

records.jp: うーん……夏だと暑さでドロドロになっちゃいそう
records.en_original: Hmm... Wouldn't it just melt since it's the summer?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... Wouldn't it just melt since it's the summer?
records.en: Hmm... Wouldn't it just melt since it's the summer?

records.jp: う、確かに……。<CR>食べるのも結構時間かかるもんね
records.en_original: Er, you're right. It'll probably take a super long time to eat it too...
records.en_auxiliary: Er, you're right. It'll probably take a super long time to eat it too...
records.en: Er, you're right. It'll<CR>probably take a super long time to eat it too...

records.jp: もっとシンプルなものがいいよ
records.en_original: I think something simpler might be better.
records.en_auxiliary: I think something simpler might be better.
records.en: I think something simpler might be better.

records.jp: 和風スイーツの屋台って、実は結構少なくない？<CR>縁日って和風なイベントなのに
records.en_original: I always thought it was weird that you don't see more traditional sweets at festivals.
records.en_auxiliary: I always thought it was weird that you don't see more traditional sweets at festivals.
records.en: I always thought it was weird that you don't see more<CR>traditional sweets at festivals.

records.jp: あー……確かに？　お団子とかは見るけど。<CR>ポン菓子……は、和菓子なのかな？
records.en_original: Hmm... You have a point. I've seen dango, though. And puffed rice... Do those count?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... You have a point. I've seen dango, though. And puffed rice... Do those count?
records.en: Hmm... You have a point. I've seen dango, though.<CR>And puffed rice... Do those count?

records.jp: 大福とか、ようかんとか、<CR>ザ・和菓子！　ってやつももっと欲しくない？
records.en_original: I'm thinking more like sweet mochi and red bean cakes. Like, iconic Japanese sweets!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm thinking more like sweet mochi and red bean cakes. Like, iconic Japanese sweets!
records.en: Wouldn't you want more truly iconic wagashi,<CR>like daifuku and youkan?

records.jp: いいね。お茶も一緒に出したら人気出そう
records.en_original: Good idea. I bet they'd be popular if we served them with green tea.
records.en_auxiliary: Good idea. I bet they'd be popular if we served them with green tea.
records.en: Good idea. I bet they'd be popular if we served them with green tea.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんって、結構甘いモノ好きだよね？
records.en_original: You sure do like sweets, don't you Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: You sure do like sweets, don't you Ao?
records.en: You sure do like sweets, don't you Ao-chan?

records.jp: もち！　スイーツは乙女のエネルギーだから。<CR>そういうこころも好きでしょ？
records.en_original: Of course! Can never have enough. You like them too, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Of course! Can never have enough. You like them too, right?
records.en: Of course! Sweets are a maiden’s energy.<CR>You like them too, right, Kokoro?

records.jp: うん、まあね。どっちかというと、<CR>わたしは食べ物全般好きだけど
records.en_original: Sure, but I like all food in general.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, but I like all food in general.
records.en: Sure, but I like all<CR>food in general.

records.jp: へっへ……甘党同士仲良くしましょうや
records.en_original: Heh heh... Us sugar addicts gotta stick together!
records.en_auxiliary: Heh heh... Us sugar addicts gotta stick together!
records.en: Heh heh... Fellow sweet-tooths should stick together.

records.jp: ふふ、何それ
records.en_original: Haha. What's that supposed to mean.
records.en_auxiliary: Haha. What's that supposed to mean.
records.en: Haha. What's that supposed to mean.

records.jp: こころと一緒にもっと色んなスイーツ食べたいなあ
records.en_original: I wanna try all kinds of different sweets with you.
records.en_auxiliary: I wanna try all kinds of different sweets with you.
records.en: I wanna try all kinds of different sweets with you.

records.jp: こころって、本当に幸せそうに食べるから、<CR>見てるこっちも楽しくなるんだよね
records.en_original: You always look so happy when you eat, it's infectious.
records.en_auxiliary: You always look so happy when you eat, it's infectious.
records.en: You look so genuinely happy when you eat, Kokoro,<CR>that watching you makes me happy too.

records.jp: うー……そう言われると恥ずかしいなあ
records.en_original: It's embarrassing when you say it like that...
records.en_auxiliary: It's embarrassing when you say it like that...
records.en: It's embarrassing when you say it like that...

records.jp: でも、わたしも愛央ちゃんと一緒に食べ歩き<CR>したりするの、好きだよ
records.en_original: But I do enjoy eating as we walk together.
records.en_auxiliary: But I do enjoy eating as we walk together.
records.en: But I like walking around and trying food<CR>together with you too, Ao-chan.

records.jp: せっかくだし、自分たちでスイーツを作るってのも、<CR>たまには良いかも……？
records.en_original: Why don't we try making our own desserts together occasionally?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't we try making our own desserts together occasionally?
records.en: Since we have the chance, maybe it'd be nice<CR>to make our own sweets once in a while?

records.jp: いいね。楽しそう。<CR>愛央ちゃんは何か作りたいもの、ある？
records.en_original: That sounds like fun. Was there something you had in mind?
records.en_auxiliary: That sounds like fun. Was there something you had in mind?
records.en: That sounds fun.<CR>Is there something you'd like to make, Ao-chan?

records.jp: って言っても、私料理はド素人だから……。<CR>簡単なのからやろう、うん
records.en_original: I'm about as much of a newbie as you can be when it comes to cooking, so something easy would be great.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm about as much of a newbie as you can be when it comes to cooking, so something easy would be great.
records.en: I'm about as much of a newbie as you can be when it comes to cooking,<CR>so something easy would be great.

records.jp: ふふ、そうだね
records.en_original: Hehe, right.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, right.
records.en: Hehe, right.
